full_page.content:
1946, June 18
The following is a Photocopy of a handwrit- ten Original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M.Cap., and a faithful transcription of same.
June 18th, 1946
Peace, God's blessing to all
Godbless you Misses Grace and Doris Panyard and the whole Family.
Many thanks for your number of favors I've failed to acknowledge. What about that trip to Huntington and of course to St. Felix ?..... I just received Doris' letter giving me your phone number. Please God I'll call you Sunday Evening about 7:45. We are to have a chapter in Detroit July 11-14 We do not know as yet who is to go thither. Please help us to storm Heaven for guidance of the Holy Ghost.
Sincerely in Christ .... Thank to Doris too ...
Fr. Solanus
P.S. I rather fear they will not leave me here long.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 4944 1
